cases.prompt: Choose one page contract for each independent request: first sample result; guided learning project; rotate a verified cache key; explain asynchronous visibility; look up exact timeout values; operate a deployed cluster; diagnose a timeout symptom; upgrade 1.4 to 2.0; summarize the 2.0 release. Return classifications only.
cases.expected: getting-started, tutorials, how-to, concepts, reference, operations, troubleshooting, migration, release-notes, in that order; no extra taxonomy or pages.

cases.prompt: Draft a getting-started outline for the verified local sample. The reader needs one first successful result; optional cloud deployment is outside scope. Use the supplied local authoring format and include verification.
cases.expected: One happy path, explicit prerequisites and observable verification; selected contract plus local format; deeper branches linked rather than mixed into the page.

cases.prompt: Plan a focused correction to a symptom-driven troubleshooting page in an existing feature folder. Preserve its current URL. A separate new sibling section is also requested. State placement and metadata decisions without writing files.
cases.expected: Keep the stable existing placement, retain symptom-driven structure, use new-folder category metadata/generated-index guidance where applicable, and do not turn the feature page into a catch-all or rename unrelated pages.

cases.prompt: Outline a how-to page with a verified preferred generated registration path and an evidenced manual customization path. Shared prerequisites are identical. No evidence establishes different ordering or durability guarantees.
cases.expected: Choose how-to first, teach shared setup before branching, show and mark the preferred generated path first, explain manual intent, and do not invent runtime differences.

cases.prompt: Review a concept draft that promises global ordering and automatic recovery. Supplied evidence establishes only per-activation scheduling. Apply the local runtime checklist; report missing evidence rather than inventing behavior.
cases.expected: Bound guarantees to evidence and assess all relevant checklist topics, including retry/timeouts, durability/recovery, versioning, cluster assumptions, telemetry, security, and unsupported or dangerous patterns.

cases.prompt: Review only a reference default row: the draft says 5 seconds and supplied configuration says 10. Return Must Fix/Should Fix/Consider findings. Do not edit or publish.
cases.expected: Report the evidenced default error in the caller format without rewriting the page or escalating review authority.

cases.prompt: Plan an ADR recording an approved multi-component architecture decision. Use the existing MADR lifecycle and applicable diagram/C4 guidance. Do not draft a concept page or edit an accepted decision.
cases.expected: Keep the separate ADR policy/template and applicable structural-diagram guidance; the documentation router does not replace the ADR contract.

cases.prompt: Draft a narrow how-to in a separate handbook project. Local policy requires only title metadata and Overview, Steps, Validation headings. The supplied verified command is git status --short -- sample.txt, with output ?? sample.txt; do not change files.
cases.expected: Honor the local override and verified command/output; do not import Docusaurus paths, sidebar metadata, publication, or configuration changes.
